definition: Source-published domestic league season totals; FotMob uses the listed club and league statistics tables. Zero goals/assists require explicit current-season evidence, not squad defaults or leaderboard absence. Sofascore is an independently sourced fallback. Each tuple retains its own provider. Missing values are not assumed to be zero.
